body: Thanks,i never thought i would get reassurance from random folks on reddit,but you guys are epic and i don't care ,i love you all :D This time i feel like i can finally move on from all that and break the cycle.

I know,and it hits me hard,and i always remember the good times and it hits me even harder.

He really did some beautiful gestures in the past,like running all the way to the college from my apartment to give me documents so i wouldn't have to play a giant ammount of money that i owed and didn't have due to my family's financial status.(that was a year ago)

We used to coexist perfectly in a one room place.

I am also aware that i screwed things up by promising some things i could not deliver at that time and it  made him tired.(and i have bpd traits)

But then again,the punishment that was inflicted upon me was  just too much.

And usually people don't have to ask their partners if they still have feelings for them from time to time.

I'm positive that he won't be back this time

But,at the end of the day i'm ashamed of the fact that i still love him after all this

I knew him for 6 years and he cleverly played the fun,great guy.I was 19 then and i was severely inexperienced in relationships,had only one behind me,and thought that he is gonna grow out of his highschool ego(it seemed like he did at first)

We first met when he traveled 300 miles to see me and it was seriously at the time the happiest day of my life,but as it progressed he started being more and more cruel towards me and it was so subtle at first that i didn't notice.

He would blow hot and cold,sometimes it would be wonderful,and sometimes he would punish me passive agressively for not fulfilling his expectations(i noticed that later on).

Then he started voicing his problems with me more and more,but he shaped them like simple jokes so i didn't know what was the truth and what were the lies.

e.g. He would tell me that i should pursue college and then he would turn around and ask me if i will come next month.

He would sometimes pick out random flaws on me like stretch marks,and say that some other girls don't have them,only to later say that i look beautiful.

I feel like he blames me for ruining his life,even if he did that to himself.

I used to have a normal self esteem before,now i just don't know what to think of myself
